messages:
Maya: FYI vendor (ClearLedger) pinged about how the A/B pricing cohorts should be reflected on their invoice export. They expect a 30-day grace for legacy partners; we currently planned to treat orgs created before 2025-06-01 as legacy. Need a decision before Fri billing run. cc @Rebecca @Liam
Liam: Can you forward the vendor CSV? they included sample rows with invoice_date, customer_id, cohort_id — we'll need that for mapping to our export.
Maya: Sent the sample to the thread. Key questions for ops/product/eng: 1) which field do we send as cohort_id in the billing export? 2) do we keep legacy partners on old rate for 90 days or indefinitely?
Ben: Product input: A/B should be 5% control vs 95% new for experiments, but for a real price rollout I'd recommend gating at 10% initially and watching invoice reconciliation. For enterprise accounts (signed contracts) we should not change billing without legal signoff. For non-contracted legacy partners, 90-day grace feels safe.
Sophia: Implementation note: our exporter already includes customer.metadata.cohort_id. I can add a `legacy_eligibility` flag so billing can apply legacy_rate where needed. Sample logic I plan to add in billing-export:
```
if customer.metadata.legacy_eligibility == 'true':
    rate = customer.metadata.legacy_rate
else:
    rate = price_sheet.lookup(customer.metadata.cohort_id)
```
I'll open a small PR and run CI.
billing-bot: billing-export CI failed on branch add-legacy-flag: 1 test failed (test_invoice_mapping) — https://ci.redwood/1234/logs
Liam: Noted. Sophia, can you triage? we must have a green export before Fri 06:00 UTC preflight.
Sophia: On it — looking at the failure. Likely null cohort_id for some vendor rows, will add defensive handling and test.
Rebecca: Quick question on refunds/credits — if we switch a customer mid-cycle and they moved from legacy to new rate, do we prorate or issue credits? Vendor also asked about retro credits for last month.
Maya: Policy: prorate for mid-cycle changes. No retrospective credits for previous closed invoices unless we (or vendor) misbilled. Rebecca, can you confirm you'll communicate that to the vendor?
Rebecca: Yup. I'll draft a vendor-facing note: outline the 90-day legacy grace, enterprise contracts excluded, no retro credits unless proven billing error. Will loop in Legal for enterprise language. :white_check_mark:
Ben: Also recommend we monitor these reconciliation metrics for the first run: match_rate (export vs vendor rows), exception_count, and any billing discrepancies. If exceptions <0.5% we can consider expanding cohort after the first billing.
Maya: Proposed decision summary: 1) 90-day grace for non-contracted legacy partners (created before 2025-06-01). 2) Enterprise contracts excluded, require Legal signoff. 3) Gate rollout to 10% traffic for first billing run. 4) No retro credits unless vendor error. 5) Rebecca to send vendor note; Liam to coordinate export and preflight; Sophia to fix CI and merge flag; Ben to monitor product metrics. Everyone ack?
Rebecca: :white_check_mark: I'll send the vendor note and copy Legal.
Liam: :thumbsup: Scheduling a preflight dry-run at 05:00 UTC Fri; will post results here.
Sophia: :white_check_mark: CI fixed and PR merged — all tests green.
Ben: :white_check_mark: Agree to 10% gate and monitoring thresholds.
Maya: Thanks all. I'll update the rollout doc and add the gating numbers. Posting summary to #support/finance once vendor note is sent.
billing-bot: Dry-run complete at 05:01 UTC — export produced 128,042 rows, 42 flagged as legacy_eligibility=true, 3 rows failed validation (missing customer_id): see logs https://ci.redwood/exports/217400/dr-logs
Maya: Good. Liam — can you confirm those 42 are expected legacy partners? If not, open tickets for mismatches.
Liam: Confirmed 39 match our legacy list, 3 mismatches opened as tickets BL-457, BL-458, BL-459 and assigned to @Sophia for data fix.
Sophia: Acknowledge, will clean up mappings and push a fix for the 3 rows.
Maya: Please put owners on those tickets and prioritize. Closing this thread once vendor note is sent and preflight passes. Thanks everyone.
